Prior experience in a customer service, administrative support, or office environment.
Assist with processing requisitions for supplies, services, and equipment while ensuring all requests are complete, accurately priced, and properly documented.
Communicate regularly with faculty, staff, and vendors to answer routine inquiries, provide order status updates, and resolve basic purchasing issues.
Support post-order operations by assisting with returns, invoice discrepancies, and the coordination of equipment repair and maintenance requests.
Escalate complex purchases, policy questions, and vendor negotiations to the Purchasing Manager or senior purchasing staff.
Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail for reviewing requests and maintaining accurate records.
Familiarity with university procurement systems (such as KFS or PalCard) or general purchasing workflows.
Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills for interacting with faculty, staff, and external vendors.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple routine requests and resolve basic billing or order discrepancies efficiently.
Ability to follow established procedures, procurement guidelines, and instructions under supervision.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
